text.en_us: Appears at the Dungeon entrance (the Old Man is not a standard town NPC)
text.zh_cn: 出现于地牢入口处（老人并非常规的城镇NPC）

text.en_us: Speak to him at night to lift the curse and challenge Skeletron
text.zh_cn: 在夜晚与其对话并解除诅咒以挑战骷髅王

text.en_us: The Old Man will no longer spawn after Skeletron is defeated
text.zh_cn: 击败骷髅王后老人将不再生成

text.en_us: If the Old Man is missing from the entrance, wait near the Dungeon for him to respawn
text.zh_cn: 若未在地牢入口处发现老人，请于地牢附近逗留片刻等待刷新

text.en_us: Found within the Dungeon's Mechanic workshop; interact to move in
text.zh_cn: 出现于地牢的机械师实验室中，交互后入住

text.en_us: Sells wrenches, wire, and other mechanical components
text.zh_cn: 出售扳手、电线等机械相关物品

text.en_us: Has a chance to drop the Rocket Wrench upon death
text.zh_cn: 死亡时有概率掉落战斗扳手

text.en_us: Has a chance to arrive in the morning and stay until night if at least 2 other NPCs reside in the world
text.zh_cn: 若世界中已有另外2个NPC，则有概率于早间到来，停留到夜晚离去

text.en_us: Sells random unique items
text.zh_cn: 出售随机独特物品

text.en_us: Drops theVendor Hat upon death
text.zh_cn: 死亡时掉落商贩帽

text.en_us: Moves in after defeating the Queen Bee
text.zh_cn: 击败蜂王后入住

text.en_us: Sells Blowpipes, the Imbuing Station, summoner gear, and related items
text.zh_cn: 出售吹箭筒、灌注站、召唤师装备等物品

text.en_us: Has a chance to move in once there are at least 20 other NPCs in the world
text.zh_cn: 若世界中已有另外20个NPC，则有概率入住

text.en_us: Sells various novelty items and toys
text.zh_cn: 出售各种有趣的小玩具

text.en_us: Has a chance to drop the Happy Grenade upon death
text.zh_cn: 死亡时有概率掉落快乐手榴弹

text.en_us: Moves in after defeating Skeletron
text.zh_cn: 击败骷髅王后入住

text.en_us: Sells vanity clothing, including outfits that hide equipped armor
text.zh_cn: 出售时装，包括能够隐藏盔甲的便装

text.en_us: Vanity Slots: The armor slots located within the Extra Accessories menu (the tree icon in the top-left of the inventory)
text.zh_cn: 时装栏：即额外栏（物品栏左上方的树状按钮）中的盔甲栏

text.en_us: Drops the Red Hat upon death
text.zh_cn: 死亡时掉落红帽

text.en_us: Fun Fact: The Old Man at the Dungeon entrance is the cursed Clothier
text.zh_cn: 热知识：地牢门口的老人就是被诅咒的服装商

text.en_us: Moves in once 10% of the Bestiary is unlocked
text.zh_cn: 解锁 10% 生物图鉴后入住

text.en_us: Sells critter-themed vanity items, mounts, and pets
text.zh_cn: 出售时装、坐骑、宠物等小动物主题物品

text.en_us: Bestiary: The book icon located in the bottom-right of the Extra Accessories menu (the tree icon in the top-left of the inventory)
text.zh_cn: 生物图鉴：即额外栏（物品栏左上方的树状按钮）右下方的书状按钮

text.en_us: Moves in during Hardmode if a suitable house exists in a surface Glowing Mushroom biome
text.zh_cn: 困难模式下，地表有处于发光蘑菇群系的可用房屋时入住

text.en_us: Sells the Autohammer, Mushroom Spear, and other mushroom-themed gear
text.zh_cn: 出售自动锤炼机、蘑菇长矛等蘑菇主题物品

text.en_us: Moves in after entering Hardmode (defeating the Wall of Flesh)
text.zh_cn: 进入困难模式（击败血肉之墙/血肉之山）后入住

text.en_us: Sells magic-related equipment and supplies
text.zh_cn: 出售魔法相关物品

text.en_us: Naturally spawns in the Underground Cavern layer (Deepslate layer)
text.zh_cn: 自然生成于地下的洞穴层（深板岩层）

text.en_us: Initially appears as the harmless Lost Girl. Transforms into the Nymph and attacks when approached
text.zh_cn: 初始伪装成人畜无害的迷失女孩，玩家靠近后变为宁芙并发起攻击
